prompts.name: Esqueleto Saqueador
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production game sprite sheet to upgrade the reference character from four to EIGHT frames per animation. Reference image contains four rows with old poses. Preserve EXACT character identity, anatomy, outfit, gear, pixel-art style and colors from the reference. EXACTLY EIGHT evenly spaced COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS = 32 complete drawings. Handled items must remain in hands consistently until deliberately released. Match the reference's existing pixel-art rendering, never change design or add new equipment.
